title: 75-9 两独立偏距反向渐变的非对称圆角
current_evidence_scope: 第33项按原图(b)改为两独立偏距反向变化：近端高窄、远端低宽，两接触缘不平行。实际OCC组合椭圆渐变三格式与连续性通过；同输入原生双端R仅作对称控制，不符合该a-law。原图精确最小张力策略和人工外观仍未确认。

generic_oracles.quantity: support geometry + finite domains + topology class
generic_oracles.method: Compare independently sampled supports/boundaries, dimensions, placements and material-side occupancy; account for allowed face subdivision. No widening, thickening or pruning source faces.

generic_oracles.expected: exactly requested faces/edges, no silent reselection
generic_oracles.method: Resolve geometric/topological selectors after import; record candidates and expected match count; ambiguous target stops score.
Native checks plus independent seam and occupancy/orientation tests. Save raw BRep even on failure.
Evaluate shared edge and both support surfaces using actual pcurves; sample endpoints/interior and adaptive extrema.
Use consistent material/sheet orientation and evaluate normals at actual seam; end caps only exempt from G1 if declared, never from G0.

target_change: Create asymmetric transition with two independently changing ranges: near end high/narrow, far end low/wide, as in source(b).
Keep source(a) constant-size symmetric case as a separate control.
must_preserve: Same y=0 wall and z=0 floor, zero-thickness open shell, x[-12,12], height11.2268032546, depth13.6709170449.
Same actual contact laws and support dimensions across engines; no symmetric scalar-radius substitute.
Red drawn arrow is blend spine, not a supplied parameter spine; do not silently use it as one.

feature_oracles.expected: a increases while b decreases from near to far
feature_oracles.method: Intersect/read actual BRep at 11+ constant-x stations; wall rail height b(t), floor rail y=a(t), match world station and endpoints.
